XOM sat, looking up at the false sky he had modeled after his short time on Gaea. It blocked out the dull purple glow of the dimension itself. The still air was cool, but comfortable. He walked into the library to grab a book to read in the isolation. A large book in the corner caught his eye. How could he have not seen it? As he approached it, he read the title, simply titled "SavageGods". It was thicker than all the other books, and seemed to vibrate in his hands. The table of contents was replaced with a list of names. At the top, was the name 'Failure'. His creator. The next was 'Silvester'. It went on, and at the end there was a 'NobleParadox', who's ink seemed to be flickering. As he turned the pages, he realized that the book wasn't written. It was being written before his very eyes. The names were talking about existence. His existence. All the other god's existence. They were *THE* gods. And before his eyes, a small note was written in the margins. From Failure to Silvester. "I'm determined to protect XOM, even if it means putting him back in stasis." XOM shut the book. He knew that there was one option. He walked outside, looked all around at the scenery. There was an edge. He took a brisk walk for about an hour, pondering what he just found. He would have to do one thing. The only thing that will allow him to survive. As the false light faded, he stopped, not of his own volition, but from the existence fading. He reached back, and punched the edge of all that was left. Light flickered, the ground shook. As XOM faded out of consciousness yet again, he knew he had done what was needed. He was no longer bound to Gaea, the Universe, the Void, or the control of these gods above him. He was floating through nothing. He passed out with the hope of colliding with the next existence.
